navigation.description: Ordered top-level navigation items. Omitted when the publication uses the default navigation.

publication.description: Required AT-URI to a `site.standard.publication` compatible record.

href.description: Resolved destination: a root-relative path or an absolute URL. Omitted for a dropdown-only label.

label.description: Display label for the navigation item.

children.description: Nested items that render as a dropdown. Up to two levels deep.

external.description: Whether the link opens an external site.
